newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romanian OTC market volume, turnover on slide.
newsitem.headline: Romanian OTC market volume, turnover on slide.

text.p: Romania's over-the-counter (OTC) market touched new lows on Thursday due to investors' wait-and-see attitude and also to computer glitches which affected trading, dealers said.
They said investors had been reluctant to buy as they saw prices of some of the more attractive listings still high. A similar trend was forecast for Friday's session.
Independent indices VAB-RA and BIG-OTC, computed by the VANGUARD and BIG brokerage houses, fell by 0.66 and 0.97 percent respectively to 3,483.1 and 2,563.38 points.
Buyers continued to focus on oil refineries and cement makers.
Oil refinery Arpechim closed 1,900 lei weaker at 22,000, while another oil refinery, Petromidia, ended flat at 18,500 lei.

Cement maker Romcim marked time at 68,000, while Moldocim, a cement maker, too, lost 1,000 lei ending at 28,500. Casial cement maker, heavily traded throughout the day, closed flat at 1,500 lei in late-trading deals.
Plane maker IAR climbed 7,500 lei to close at 45,000 under strong buying pressure. But volumes remained light due to thin supply.
Traders said buying interest in IAR had been swelled by the announcement on Wednesday that U.S. helicopter maker Bell Helicopter Textron would buy a 70 percent stake in IAR.
Investors already holding large IAR share packages were reluctant to sell, expecting new highs for the stock.
Turnover fell to 4.13 billion lei from 7.61 billion on Wednesday. Volume slipped slightly to 2.0 million shares from 2.6 million. ($=7,085 lei)
